note_to_reviewer: Pre-registration file per coordinator directive 2026-08-29 item 3: this file's own SHA-256 is meant to be recorded in the ADR and signed alongside it. DO NOT EDIT after that hash is recorded -- any edit changes the hash. Both sub-probes below write the SAME two strings (fixture_text then probe_text) into the SAME conceptual single block (id/type/parent/index all identical across both sub-probes) so the two metrics remain a like-for-like workload; only the write/read MECHANISM differs (adapter-API-only vs DOM+adapter-API), matching ADR-0015 R4 3.2 item 4's split.
fixture_checksum_note: SHA-256 of fixture_text as UTF-8 bytes, hex-encoded. Covers the bootstrap write's content only (before probe_text is appended).

engine_runtime_ready_probe.description: ADR-0015 3.2 item 4, engine_runtime_ready half: adapter-API-only, zero DOM, zero ProseMirror import. Implemented by probe/src/loro-engine-only-entry.ts and probe/src/yrs-yjs-engine-only-entry.ts (dedicated build entries, see probe/vite.config.*.mjs; verified to contain zero prosemirror-family modules by probe/check-module-graph.mjs).

loro: id = String(block.get("id")); type = String(block.get("type")); parent = String(block.get("parent")); index = Number(block.get("index")); text_out = text.toString()
yrs-yjs: id = String(block.get("id")); type = String(block.get("type")); parent = String(block.get("parent")); index = Number(block.get("index")); text_out = text.toString()

engine_runtime_ready_probe.canonical_encoding: JSON.stringify([{id, type, parent, index, text}]) with keys in exactly this order; single-element array (one block); text = fixture_text + probe_text (post both writes, no separator).
engine_runtime_ready_probe.expected_semantic_hash_note: Full 64-hex-char SHA-256 of expected_canonical_json as UTF-8 bytes -- not a prefix. Same value expected for BOTH candidates (loro and yrs-yjs), since both implement the identical call sequence shape and must produce identical observable state -- this is the genuine cross-candidate semantic check.
engine_runtime_ready_probe.comparison_authority: The harness (not candidate/adapter code) computes SHA-256 of the actual read-back canonical JSON and compares it to expected_semantic_hash_sha256 verbatim. Neither loro-engine-only-entry.ts nor yrs-yjs-engine-only-entry.ts contains any comparison or boolean self-report -- readBackBlocks() only returns the observed block array; the runner (measure-engine-runtime-ready.mjs) does the hashing and comparison.

flow_route_cold_load_probe.description: ADR-0015 3.2 item 4, flow_route_cold_load half: DOM probe via synthetic keyboard input into the real ProseMirror EditorView (postconditions 1-5, including mount+rAF).
adapter_call_sequence: -- read-back: DOM only, see known_gap below --
blocks = Array.from(document.querySelector('.ProseMirror').children).map((el, index) => ({ parent: 'root', index, type: el.tagName.toLowerCase(), text: el.textContent }))
flow_route_cold_load_probe.canonical_encoding: JSON.stringify([{parent, index, type, text}]) with keys in exactly this order; single-element array; text = fixture_text + probe_text as typed via two sequential keyboard events into the one pre-existing default paragraph (neither candidate wires a keymap plugin -- no Enter-splits-paragraph command exists, confirmed empirically, see lib/common.mjs's EXPECTED_PROBE_BLOCKS header comment).
flow_route_cold_load_probe.expected_semantic_hash_note: Full 64-hex-char SHA-256 of expected_canonical_json as UTF-8 bytes -- not a prefix.
flow_route_cold_load_probe.comparison_authority: The harness (lib/browser-harness-src.mjs's readBackAndHashBlocks, injected via evaluateOnNewDocument before any candidate script runs) computes this hash and compares; candidate code never sees expected_semantic_hash_sha256 and has no path to self-report ok.
flow_route_cold_load_probe.known_gap_not_yet_closed: This sub-probe's read-back is DOM-only, NOT independently cross-checked against CRDT state (LoroDoc/Y.Doc), unlike the engine_runtime_ready sub-probe above. Root cause: `mountFlowEditor` is the ONLY export of bundle-loro/src/flow-entry.ts and bundle-yrs-yjs/src/flow-entry.ts, it always constructs a ProseMirror EditorView bound to an internal, non-exported LoroDoc/Y.Doc instance, and main.ts (not this harness) is what calls it during real route navigation -- so this harness has no reachable JS reference to that specific run's CRDT document instance, and no known robust way to obtain one without either (a) a source change to flow-entry.ts adding an export (out of this delivery's file scope: spikes/coldstart-measure/** only), or (b) a fragile, version-specific internal-API technique (`dom.pmViewDesc`) that was investigated and found NOT to expose a `.view` back-reference in the installed prosemirror-view version (see delivery report). The `id` field is deliberately OMITTED from this sub-probe's compared shape (rather than filled with a value nothing verifies) to avoid implying a CRDT-identity check that is not actually performed. This is flagged to the coordinator as an open item, not silently worked around.
